// SYNTAX TEST "source.ds"

// expressions / using / sync
using file = open(path);
// <- keyword.control.using.ds

// expressions / using / async
await using connection = await pool.connect();
//    ^^^^^ keyword.control.using.ds

// expressions / using / loops
for (using file of files) {
//   ^^^^^ keyword.control.using.ds
    process(file);
}
